description: Invented Codex folder-permission picker with numbered rows under a › highlight and a key-hint footer worded unlike Codex 0.162's "enter continue · esc back". A tap must walk it with arrows and Enter: the footer names arrows to move and Enter to choose, so a digit is no commit here. The model reads that off the footer itself (no code keys on the wording any longer), so a reworded footer still yields a cursor picker with the default keymap.
